test_cases.ground_truth: outdoor safety restrictions | adult-supervised outdoor safety
test_cases.expected_evidence: Laura repeatedly sets outdoor boundaries such as porch, oak, and flower bed, and says Randy must stop if he cannot see her; calendar notes warn against roads, ponds alone, ditches, and long moving things in weeds.
